title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
summary: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.
title_es: OpenAI presenta GPT-6 Cyber para agentes de ciberseguridad
bajada: OpenAI lanzó GPT-6 Cyber, un modelo especializado en encontrar vulnerabilidades explotables y desarrollar soluciones de seguridad. El modelo está entrenado para mantenerse dentro del alcance autorizado, marcando un avance en la automatización de tareas de ciberseguridad.
bajada_en: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, a specialized model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing security fixes. The model is trained to stay within authorized scope, marking an advance in automating cybersecurity tasks.

title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
summary: Text "Gemini Introducing Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash" surroudned by images of a beehive, animals in conversation, a squid, and a woman walking down a street
title_es: Google presenta Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash más rápido y económico
bajada: Google lanzó Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, una versión optimizada de su modelo multimodal con mejor rendimiento y costos reducidos. Soporta clips más largos, mejorando la capacidad para procesar contenido visual y de audio extendido.
bajada_en: Google launched Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, an optimized version of its multimodal model with improved performance and reduced costs. It supports longer clips, enhancing the ability to process extended visual and audio content.

title: Vera Delivers the Best of Both Worlds: Highest Throughput and Fastest Agents
summary: AI agents do more than generate answers. They search for information, query databases, write and test code and take action.  Each of those steps relies on a CPU, with agents moving between GPU reasoning and CPU execution throughout a task.  As businesses put more agents to work, AI factories need CPUs that can execute those […]
title_es: NVIDIA presenta Vera para agentes de IA de alto rendimiento
bajada: NVIDIA anunció Vera, una solución que optimiza el equilibrio entre throughput y latencia en agentes de IA. La plataforma mejora la ejecución en CPU de tareas complejas que requieren alternancia entre razonamiento en GPU y ejecución en CPU.
bajada_en: NVIDIA announced Vera, a solution that optimizes the balance between throughput and latency in AI agents. The platform improves CPU execution for complex tasks requiring switching between GPU reasoning and CPU execution.

title: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
summary: Perplexity is taking on OpenAI and Anthropic with its own work-focused AI agents. The startup's new always-on "Teammates" can take on multiple roles within a workspace, while pulling existing projects, skills, and memory from the Perplexity tools you already use. Teammates integrate with Perplexity Computer, an AI system that can deploy agents on your device […]
title_es: Perplexity lanza Teammates, agentes de IA para el trabajo
bajada: Perplexity presentó Teammates, agentes de IA siempre activos que pueden asumir múltiples roles en espacios de trabajo. Los agentes se integran con Perplexity Computer y acceden a proyectos, habilidades y memoria existentes dentro del ecosistema.
bajada_en: Perplexity unveiled Teammates, always-on AI agents that can assume multiple roles within workspaces. The agents integrate with Perplexity Computer and access existing projects, skills, and memory within the ecosystem.

title: Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account
summary: Anthropic has a new pitch for managing your personal finances: let Claude do it instead, with a new Personal Finance feature that connects it to your bank and card accounts via the Plaid bank bridging platform. You can ask the chatbot "where did my money go this month," for example, and it'll create an overview […]
title_es: Claude puede conectarse directamente a tu cuenta bancaria
bajada: Anthropic integró a Claude con Plaid para permitir gestión de finanzas personales mediante IA. Los usuarios pueden hacer preguntas sobre sus gastos y Claude analiza sus cuentas bancarias para proporcionar resumen de movimientos.
bajada_en: Anthropic integrated Claude with Plaid to enable personal finance management through AI. Users can ask questions about their spending and Claude analyzes their bank accounts to provide transaction summaries.

title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
title_es: NVIDIA Cosmos 3: modelos abiertos para simulación interactiva
bajada: NVIDIA lanzó nuevos modelos abiertos de Cosmos 3 para simulación interactiva del mundo. Estos modelos permiten a desarrolladores crear y simular escenarios complejos con IA generativa.
bajada_en: NVIDIA released new open Cosmos 3 models for interactive world simulation. These models enable developers to create and simulate complex scenarios with generative AI.

title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
summary: Speaking at a Wall Street Journal tech conference on Wednesday, the executive touted how the company had been gaining ground in the enterprise market, where rival Anthropic had already successfully made inroads.
title_es: OpenAI podría estar lista para IPO en 2027, según ejecutivo
bajada: Greg Brockman, presidente de OpenAI, indicó que la compañía podría estar lista para salida a bolsa en 2027. Brockman destacó el crecimiento en el mercado empresarial, competiendo con Anthropic en ese segmento.
bajada_en: OpenAI president Greg Brockman indicated the company could be IPO-ready in 2027. Brockman highlighted growth in the enterprise market, competing with Anthropic in that segment.

title: Tencent Launches Hy4, One of the Leading Open-Source AI Models
summary: Article URL:https://www.tencent.com/tencent-launches-hy4-joining-the-ranks-of-the-worlds-leading-open-source-ai-models/Comments URL:https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50383963Points: 80# Comments: 2
title_es: Tencent lanza Hy4, modelo de IA de código abierto líder
bajada: Tencent presentó Hy4, un modelo de IA de código abierto que se posiciona entre los líderes globales. El modelo está disponible para la comunidad de desarrolladores con licencia abierta.
bajada_en: Tencent unveiled Hy4, an open-source AI model positioned among global leaders. The model is available to the developer community under an open license.

title: Cyera’s $800 Million Haul Shows Cyber Fever Hasn’t Broken
summary: Last week my colleagues Jemima and Validascoopedthat Cyera, a five-year-old cloud security startup, was mulling a new fundraise at an eye-popping $20 billion valuation, up from $12 billion in June.Since then, those talks have gotten more serious, I’ve learned. Cyera is indeed planning to raise around $800 million in a round led by Cyberstarts, which wrote the startup’s first seed check in 2021, according to two people with knowledge of the deal.
title_es: Cyera recauda $800M a valoración de $20 mil millones
bajada: Cyera, startup de ciberseguridad en la nube, está recaudando $800 millones en una ronda liderada por Cyberstarts. La valoración alcanza $20 mil millones, reflejando demanda sostenida por soluciones de seguridad en IA.
bajada_en: Cyera, a cloud security startup, is raising $800 million in a round led by Cyberstarts. The valuation reaches $20 billion, reflecting sustained demand for AI security solutions.

title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
summary: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.
title_es: Airbnb planea lanzar agente de IA de viajes en 2027
bajada: Airbnb anunció que lanzará un agente de IA en la primera mitad de 2027 para planificar viajes, comparar opciones y gestionar reservas. La herramienta asistirá a viajeros a lo largo de toda su experiencia de booking.
bajada_en: Airbnb announced it will launch an AI agent in the first half of 2027 to plan trips, compare options, and manage bookings. The tool will assist travelers throughout their entire booking experience.

title: OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects
summary: Following this week's midterms where voters resoundingly voiced their opposition to data center expansion, OpenAI today announced new commitments to communities where it is working on data center projects, including that it won't use non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) with public officials. Many data center projects have come under scrutiny for relying on NDAs to hide discussions […]
title_es: OpenAI se retracta de NDAs en proyectos de centros de datos
bajada: OpenAI anunció que no usará acuerdos de confidencialidad (NDAs) con funcionarios públicos en sus proyectos de centros de datos. La decisión responde a creciente escrutinio público sobre expansión de infraestructura de IA.
bajada_en: OpenAI announced it won't use non-disclosure agreements with public officials for its data center projects. The decision responds to growing public scrutiny over AI infrastructure expansion.

title: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.
title_es: Phonon TTS: síntesis de voz de alto rendimiento en dispositivos
bajada: Phonon lanzó un modelo de TTS de alta calidad optimizado para ejecutarse localmente en dispositivos. El modelo supera benchmarks existentes en calidad de síntesis de voz sin requerir conexión a servidores.
bajada_en: Phonon launched a high-quality TTS model optimized to run locally on devices. The model outperforms existing benchmarks in speech synthesis quality without requiring server connectivity.

title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
summary: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.
title_es: Meta permite videollamadas con avatares de IA personalizados
bajada: Meta habilitó videollamadas con avatares animados personalizados de su agente Muse para usuarios en EE.UU. La funcionalidad anticipa el lanzamiento de un wearable estilo Tamagotchi dedicado a Muse.
bajada_en: Meta enabled video calls with customizable animated avatars of its Muse AI agent for US users. The feature previews the upcoming launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable dedicated to Muse.

title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
summary: Turning a simulation idea into a working application means assembling assets, connecting physics and rendering, and checking that the scene behaves as intended. Developers are combining frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to help carry out that work — building applications for exploring scenarios, investigating failures and improving designs. Developers direct AI agents through […]
title_es: Desarrolladores usan agentes de IA para crear simulaciones con Omniverse
bajada: Desarrolladores combinan modelos de IA frontier con librerías de NVIDIA Omniverse para construir aplicaciones de simulación. Los agentes de IA automatizan tareas de ensamblaje de assets, conexión de física y validación de escenas.
bajada_en: Developers combine frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to build simulation applications. AI agents automate asset assembly, physics connection, and scene validation tasks.

title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
summary: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. Its teams also use AI to plan executive dinners and prepare sales updates.
title_es: Merge construye herramientas de producto con tecnología OpenAI
bajada: Merge utiliza GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT y Codex para revisar código de productos y soportar marketing. El caso muestra cómo empresas integran múltiples modelos de OpenAI en flujos de trabajo empresariales complejos.
bajada_en: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. The case shows how companies integrate multiple OpenAI models into complex enterprise workflows.

title: Free Chinese AI Models Are Getting Scary Good at Hacking
summary: An experiment in which AI models were asked to break into simulated networks showed the hacking skills of DeepSeek and GLM to be not far behind OpenAI’s most advanced cyber model, which isn’t public.
title_es: Modelos chinos de IA mejoran rápidamente en hacking
bajada: Un análisis experimental reveló que DeepSeek y GLM alcanzan capacidades de hacking comparables a los modelos más avanzados de OpenAI en ciberseguridad. Este hallazgo plantea preocupaciones sobre la proliferación de capacidades de ataque y la brecha cada vez menor entre modelos de diferentes regiones.
bajada_en: An experimental analysis revealed that DeepSeek and GLM achieve hacking capabilities comparable to OpenAI's most advanced cybersecurity models. This finding raises concerns about the proliferation of attack capabilities and the narrowing gap between models from different regions.

title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
summary: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.
title_es: Gasto en IA se estanca mientras Anthropic prepara IPO
bajada: Datos de Ramp muestran que aunque el uso de IA crece, el gasto se ha desacelerado debido a reducciones de precio y controles de costos más inteligentes entre grandes consumidores. El fenómeno podría desafiar las expectativas de inversores sobre el crecimiento acelerado de la IA.
bajada_en: Ramp data shows that while AI usage grows, spending has stalled due to price cuts and smarter cost controls among major consumers. This trend could challenge investor expectations about AI's accelerated growth trajectory.

title: TSMC Weighs Making Advanced Memory Chips to Capture More AI Spending
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. is considering expanding into the advanced memory chip manufacturing sector, a move that would give the world’s largest chipmaker an even bigger share of the AI hardware supply chain, according to two people with direct knowledge of the matter.The Taiwanese chipmaking giant recently started drawing up plans for making a specific type of advanced memory chips, 3D DRAM, at the request of Nvidia, its biggest customer, the two people said. An intense shortage of memory chips, driven by the AI hardware boom, has sent prices soaring and prompted chip designers such asNvidiaandAppleto look for sources of additional supply. Apple earlier this year hiked prices for its devices, citing rising memory costs.
title_es: TSMC considera fabricar chips de memoria avanzada para IA
bajada: TSMC evalúa expandirse hacia la fabricación de chips de memoria 3D DRAM a pedido de NVIDIA, su mayor cliente, para capturar más de la cadena de suministro de hardware de IA. La escasez de memoria impulsada por el boom de IA ha disparado precios y presiona a diseñadores como NVIDIA y Apple a buscar más fuentes.
bajada_en: TSMC is considering expanding into 3D DRAM memory chip manufacturing at NVIDIA's request to capture more of the AI hardware supply chain. The memory shortage driven by the AI boom has sent prices soaring and pressures chipmakers to seek additional suppliers.

title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
summary: Security researchers found hundreds of servers hosting the penetration testing tool Artex exposed to the internet, allowing anyone access to the hacking tool.
title_es: Herramientas de hacking Artex expuestas en internet
bajada: Investigadores de seguridad descubrieron cientos de servidores con la herramienta de pruebas de penetración Artex expuestos públicamente, permitiendo acceso sin autorización. El incidente subraya los riesgos de exponer infraestructura de seguridad crítica.
bajada_en: Security researchers discovered hundreds of servers hosting the Artex penetration testing tool publicly exposed, allowing unauthorized access. The incident highlights the risks of exposing critical security infrastructure.

title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
summary: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.
title_es: Meta introduce Spaces para agentes Muse
bajada: Meta añadió Spaces, una nueva característica que permite crear experiencias personalizadas dentro del asistente Muse, como dashboards de compras, trackers de música y juegos. La funcionalidad amplía las capacidades de los agentes IA de Meta para adaptarse a necesidades específicas del usuario.
bajada_en: Meta added Spaces, a new feature allowing users to create customized experiences within the Muse assistant, such as shopping hubs, music trackers, and games. The functionality expands Meta's AI agents' capabilities to adapt to specific user needs.

title: AI Companies Really, Really Want to Buy Your Work Files and Emails
summary: Data brokers are collecting all sorts of internal corporate files to help train AI models. Not everyone is thrilled.
title_es: Empresas de IA buscan comprar archivos de trabajo y correos
bajada: Agentes de datos están recopilando archivos corporativos internos para entrenar modelos de IA, lo que genera preocupación sobre privacidad y seguridad empresarial. La práctica plantea interrogantes sobre el consentimiento informado y la regulación del uso de datos sensibles.
bajada_en: Data brokers are collecting internal corporate files to train AI models, raising concerns about privacy and enterprise security. The practice raises questions about informed consent and regulation of sensitive data usage.

title: How a Blue Wave midterm might reshape the AI industry
summary: Democrats’ historic victories in this week’s U.S. midterm elections could also transform the tech industry. The public voted on 41 data center-related ballot measures on Tuesday — in all but one, the majority voted to impose more restrictions on data center development. And even when data centers weren’t on the ballot directly, they were a […]
title_es: Resultados electorales podrían reformar regulación de IA
bajada: Las victorias demócratas en elecciones intermedias estadounidenses coinciden con restricciones votadas a centros de datos en 41 medidas de votación. El resultado sugiere que el enfoque regulatorio sobre infraestructura de IA podría endurecerse significativamente.
bajada_en: Democratic victories in U.S. midterm elections coincide with voter-approved restrictions on data centers in 41 ballot measures. The result suggests that regulatory focus on AI infrastructure could significantly tighten.

title: University libraries are being swarmed by AI bots, putting public access at risk
summary: Article URL:https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/university-libraries-ai-data-scraping-bots-9.7408287Comments URL:https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50392499Points: 109# Comments: 49
title_es: Bots de IA saturan bibliotecas universitarias públicas
bajada: Bots de IA están desbordando las bibliotecas universitarias con scraping masivo de contenido, poniendo en riesgo el acceso público a recursos académicos. El fenómeno plantea tensiones entre el entrenamiento de IA y la preservación de instituciones públicas de conocimiento.
bajada_en: AI bots are overwhelming university libraries with massive content scraping, risking public access to academic resources. The phenomenon creates tension between AI training needs and the preservation of public knowledge institutions.

title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
summary: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.
title_es: OpenAI se asocia con Hacktron para encontrar vulnerabilidades
bajada: OpenAI estableció una asociación con Hacktron para identificar y corregir vulnerabilidades en sus sistemas, incluyendo pruebas de conexiones con servicios terceros. Esta iniciativa refuerza el enfoque de seguridad de la compañía antes de desplegar modelos más avanzados.
bajada_en: OpenAI partnered with Hacktron to identify and fix vulnerabilities in its systems, including testing third-party service connections. This initiative reinforces the company's security focus ahead of deploying more advanced models.

title: Meta’s Muse AI can create custom ‘spaces’ for the version of the app you need right now
summary: Meta will now allow you to build customized, app-like experiences within its Muse AI assistant. The new feature, called "spaces," allows Muse to build things like a shopping hub, school dashboard, music tracker, trivia game, and more, which you can interact with directly in the app. If you connect your space to a relevant app, […]
title_es: Meta amplía Muse con espacios personalizados
bajada: Meta expandió su asistente Muse permitiendo crear espacios personalizados que actúan como mini-aplicaciones dentro de la plataforma, desde tiendas hasta dashboards educativos. Esta característica mejora la experiencia de usuario y demuestra la tendencia hacia agentes IA más contextuales y adaptables.
bajada_en: Meta expanded its Muse assistant by allowing users to create customized spaces that function as mini-apps within the platform, from shopping hubs to educational dashboards. This feature enhances user experience and shows the trend toward more contextual and adaptable AI agents.

title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
summary: A year ago, NVIDIA open sourced its Aerial wireless software, joining Sionna and a broader suite of open source tools for accelerating next-generation 6G network development. Together, they give researchers a foundation for testing ideas, comparing results and building on each other’s work — connecting simulation and AI training with experiments on real over-the-air wireless […]
title_es: NVIDIA libera herramientas open source para redes 6G
bajada: NVIDIA compartió herramientas open source como Aerial y Sionna para acelerar la investigación de redes 6G de próxima generación. El suite permite a investigadores probar ideas, comparar resultados y construir sobre el trabajo de otros en simulación y entrenamiento de IA.
bajada_en: NVIDIA released open source tools like Aerial and Sionna to accelerate next-generation 6G network research. The suite allows researchers to test ideas, compare results, and build on each other's work in simulation and AI training.

title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
title_es: ToyBlocks: Entorno controlado para aprendizaje robótico
bajada: Allen AI presentó ToyBlocks, un entorno simulado controlado diseñado para entrenar y evaluar modelos de aprendizaje robótico. La herramienta facilita la investigación en robótica al proporcionar un espacio reproducible para pruebas.
bajada_en: Allen AI presented ToyBlocks, a controlled simulated environment designed to train and evaluate robot learning models. The tool facilitates robotics research by providing a reproducible space for testing.

title: Amazon will let you text Alexa your shopping list
summary: Amazon is adding a new feature to Alexa for Shopping that allows customers to purchase items by texting the AI shopping assistant. Users can describe the products they're looking to buy and/or provide a photograph of the item, and Alexa for Shopping will search for matching results in Amazon listings, text back with recommendations, and […]
title_es: Amazon permite enviar listas de compras por texto a Alexa
bajada: Amazon agregó una función a Alexa for Shopping que permite comprar describiendo productos por texto o compartiendo fotos, con recomendaciones devueltas vía mensajes. La característica refuerza la tendencia de usar mensajería de texto como interfaz estándar para agentes IA.
bajada_en: Amazon added a feature to Alexa for Shopping allowing users to purchase by texting product descriptions or sharing photos, with recommendations returned via messages. The feature reinforces the trend of text messaging as a standard interface for AI agents.

title: Amazon Says Shoppers Can Now Text With AI Shopping Assistant Alexa For Shopping
summary: Amazon has introduced a feature to its Alexa for Shopping service where users can text the AI shopping assistant directly. The move signals how text messaging is becoming a standard communication tool for agents. Meta’s Muse and Instinct both let users interact with them via text messages, while ...
title_es: Amazon expande asistente de compras Alexa con texting
bajada: Amazon lanzó la capacidad de interactuar con Alexa for Shopping vía mensajes de texto directos, permitiendo a usuarios describir productos y recibir recomendaciones. El movimiento demuestra cómo la mensajería se convierte en interfaz estándar para agentes IA comerciales.
bajada_en: Amazon launched the ability to interact with Alexa for Shopping via direct text messages, letting users describe products and receive recommendations. The move shows how messaging is becoming a standard interface for commercial AI agents.

title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
summary: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.
title_es: Universidades australianas forman graduados nativos en IA
bajada: Universidades australianas expanden el acceso a ChatGPT e integran IA en la enseñanza para preparar estudiantes para una fuerza laboral habilitada por IA. La iniciativa refleja la transformación educativa provocada por la adopción generalizada de modelos de lenguaje.
bajada_en: Australian universities expanded ChatGPT access and integrated AI into teaching to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce. The initiative reflects the educational transformation driven by widespread adoption of language models.
